answer: Each identity must present a hardware secret fused into silicon, unclonable and metered at manufacture. Claiming a new agent means buying another chip at foundry cost, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand physical units. Register growth stays glacial, a glacier pace, and an attacker's spend hits its zenith long before the honest meadow fills with fakes. Software-only forgery fails outright: the attestation challenge cannot be cloned or replayed.
